A major priority will be helping TBI successfully deliver its next Cyber Essentials / Cyber Essentials Plus certification. We therefore particularly want to hear from engineers who have taken an organisation through the certification process before and understand how to translate security requirements into practical technical remediation.
Alongside this, you will provide senior 3rd-line infrastructure expertise across our Microsoft 365 and cloud environment and work closely with our Technical Architect, infrastructure and support teams, and managed Security Operations Centre (SOC).
Please note: candidates must already have the right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Infrastructure & Platform Management: Maintain and support the 3rd line infrastructure estate, managing the Azure platform (PaaS, IaaS, VNETs and storage accounts) and the wider M365 estate, including Exchange Online, Teams (incl. telephony integration), OneDrive and SharePoint Online.
• Security Operations: Act as the primary internal liaison with the managed third-party SOC, monitoring and responding to security alerts using Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel, and supporting incident triage, containment and root cause analysis.
• Vulnerability & Patch Management: Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, track remediation progress and support patch management across the estate.
• Compliance & Certification: Support Cyber Essentials (and Cyber Essentials Plus) certification activities, implementing and recommending remediations to close identified gaps, and assist with internal and external audits and security assessments.
• Collaboration: Work closely with the Technical Architect to design and implement secure, scalable infrastructure solutions, and with the IT Service Desk and wider Infrastructure team to ensure secure configurations and timely resolution of issues.
• Data Protection & Email Security: Assist with the management and configuration of email protection, web control, data loss prevention (DLP) and device monitoring platforms.
• Threat Intelligence & Policy: Contribute to threat intelligence analysis and recommend defensive improvements; support the development and maintenance of security policies, procedures and technical standards.
• Automation & Documentation: Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate routine administrative and security tasks, and produce and maintain accurate system documentation.
• Backup & Resilience: Manage and test M365 and Azure backup and disaster recovery arrangements.

• Azure platform management experience, including PaaS, IaaS, VNETs and storage accounts.

• PowerShell scripting experience.

About Toolbox
Toolbox is a Technology company founded in 2013. Our Vision is to Become the fastest Technology Solutions Provider across industries and our Mission is to “Act as the key business partner across industries by enabling the generation of new profitable business through the use of our unique know how to develop technology”. We deliver SPEED.

Our current successes are in the online TV industry. We provide a wide range of products covering User Authentication & Authorization Services, Content Aggregation & Distribution and App Development for End Users, aimed to Content Providers and Multiple Services Operators.

We are a product company, our goal is to guide and accompany market development, building solutions which can be leveraged by as many clients as possible. Our products are used by hundreds of Content Providers and Service Operators in the five continents: WARNER MEDIA, NBC UNIVERSAL, SONY, ATRESMEDIA, PARAMOUNT, DIRECTV among them. 90% of internet traffic related to Online TV in Latin America goes through Toolbox.

At Toolbox we work with cutting edge technology to build robust, high availability systems, able to handle high load and concurrency. We look for people bringing fresh ideas from the high concurrency system design, non-structured data organization, distributed computing, API design and Mobile areas.

Excellent communication skills, both oral and written English 
Strong customer orientation

Good interpersonal skills and confidence level to communicate with international clients and stakeholders 
Ability to perform under stress

Good database and SQL skills

Regional Director of Operations, UK, Europe and Africa

Kenyon International Emergency Services, part of the TrustFlight Group
Bracknell, United Kingdom | Full time, permanent | Competitive salary and benefits package

When the worst happens, families need someone they can trust. Lead that response.
When an aircraft is lost, a ship is in distress or a community is struck by disaster, families are suddenly facing the hardest days of their lives. They need answers, they need to be treated with dignity, and they need to know that the people they have lost are being cared for. For more than a century, Kenyon International Emergency Services has been the organisation that airlines, governments and major companies call on to make sure that happens.

We are looking for a senior crisis leader to direct that response across the UK, Europe and Africa. This is a role for someone who has stood in the room when it mattered, who leads with calm authority, and who believes that how an organisation treats the bereaved and the injured says everything about its character.

About Kenyon
Kenyon provides emergency planning, family assistance, humanitarian support and recovery services to clients around the world, drawing on a network of more than 2,500 trained responders who can be mobilised at short notice into any jurisdiction. Our clients rely on us to keep their promises to the people affected by an incident, and we hold ourselves to that standard every day, not only on the day of an activation.

Kenyon is part of the TrustFlight Group, an aviation safety and compliance technology business. That gives Kenyon something unusual in this sector: a world class technology team working alongside it, and a genuine commitment to using AI to make crisis response faster, better informed and more humane. Our values are simple and we mean them: integrity, and a customer first attitude in everything we do.

The role
Kenyon operates a two hub leadership model. You will lead the Bracknell hub, with regional accountability for operational delivery, readiness, contracted offices and relationships across the UK, Europe and Africa. Your peer, the Regional Director of Operations in Vancouver, leads the Americas and Asia Pacific. Together you share accountability for the readiness and quality of Kenyon’s response worldwide.

Senior Incident Director for activations
Senior on call duty is shared between the two Directors on a fixed twelve hour rota, with a structured handover at each change of duty, so that cover is continuous around the clock and neither Director works through their own night. Your window runs from approximately 06:00 to 18:00 UK time.

When an incident arises during your window, wherever in the world it occurs, you take up the role of Senior Incident Director. You will have the authority to set the deployment posture, commit responders and stand the organisation up or down without further approval. Where a client requires it, you will deploy as their strategic point of contact, leading the response on their behalf at the most demanding moments an organisation can face, including mass casualty, government led and politically sensitive events.

Major activations are infrequent, and Kenyon holds its capability through a surge based model rather than a large permanent workforce. Your judgement of regional readiness, kept current every week of the year, is what makes that model work.

What you will lead
· Regional readiness and response. Maintain and continuously measure activation readiness across the UK, Europe and Africa, and develop the procedures, protocols and contingency plans that underpin it.
· Your team and offices. Line manage the Regional Operations Manager in Bracknell, run the Bracknell hub and its regional operations as one regional function, and hold contracted offices to defined standards through quarterly reviews and an annual assessment.
· Protecting those we serve. Make sure the information of casualties, families and clients is protected with the same care during and after an activation as on any other day.
· The responder network. Work with the Responder Manager to keep the network vetted, trained and available across the region, including building language capable responders across Europe and Africa. Own the global standards for responder vetting, training currency, deployment conduct and post incident review, ensuring they are consistently applied across both hubs.

· Relationships that matter. Build trusted working relationships with government agencies, emergency services, aviation authorities and clients across the region, and provide the operational insight that informs board level reporting.

· Real authority. A senior seat on the Kenyon leadership team, reporting to the Managing Director, with decision making authority during activations.
· A sustainable model. A shared rota designed so that no Director carries standing 24/7 availability, because sound judgement depends on rest.
· Room to build. The opportunity to shape Kenyon’s growth across the UK, Europe and Africa, while leading the development of global quality, certification and responder standards and helping shape how AI strengthens operational assurance across Kenyon.

Job Description
Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Commercial Contract Manager to support a major UK infrastructure and energy programme. This role will sit within the client team and be responsible for leading contract change management activities across multiple complex and strategic contracts.
You will work closely with senior commercial stakeholders to ensure that contract changes are identified, assessed, governed and implemented effectively while supporting programme objectives, commercial outcomes and risk management requirements.
This is an exciting opportunity to support the establishment and delivery of a first of a kind major programme environment, requiring individuals who are comfortable operating in a fast-paced setting with evolving priorities, ambiguity and complex stakeholder landscapes.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the identification, assessment, governance and management of contract changes across multiple commercial workstreams.
Ensure effective approval, documentation and implementation of contractual changes in line with governance requirements.
Manage change control processes, including evaluation of cost, schedule, risk and operational impacts.
Support the negotiation and agreement of contract changes with suppliers, contractors and key stakeholders.
Lead contract management activities for one or more high-profile, complex and strategic contracts.
Manage all aspects of the contract lifecycle including mobilisation, delivery, performance management, change control, transition and contract close-out activities.
Ensure effective stakeholder engagement, governance, performance management, risk mitigation, escalation and compliance throughout contract execution.
Assess and manage contract variations, providing practical advice and commercial recommendations.
Support the development and implementation of programme-wide contract change and commercial governance frameworks.
Evaluate contract performance and value for money, ensuring contracts deliver intended commercial and strategic outcomes.
Oversee the realisation and tracking of benefits arising from contract performance improvement and change initiatives.
Drive innovation and continuous improvement across contract management and commercial processes.
Manage risk and reward mechanisms, contractual incentives and KPI performance frameworks.
Identify opportunities to improve contract outcomes through effective change strategies and commercial interventions.
Lead supplier performance management activities, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and delivery of agreed outcomes.
Resolve commercial issues and disputes in a proactive and collaborative manner.
Advise on and mitigate risks to continuity of supply, operational delivery and programme performance.
Maintain accurate contract records, management information, reporting and commercial documentation.
Support procurement and commercial activities where contract amendments, variations or new contractual arrangements are required.
Work within project governance frameworks and industry best practice to deliver compliant and effective commercial outcomes.
Prepare and present clear commercial reporting, recommendations and change approvals to senior stakeholders.
Qualifications
Essential
Significant experience in contract management, contract change management or commercial management on major infrastructure, engineering or energy programmes.
Strong understanding of end-to-end contract lifecycle management principles.
Experience managing medium to high-value, high-risk and complex contracts.
Demonstrable experience managing contractual change processes, including governance, approvals and implementation.
Experience negotiating contract variations, claims and commercial settlements.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to evaluate value for money and contractual performance.
Knowledge of contract law principles and their practical application.
Experience managing commercial risks and developing mitigation strategies.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all organisational levels.
Experience developing and maintaining contract management plans, reporting and performance frameworks.
Desirable
Experience procuring consultancy, engineering, construction or major project contracts.
Understanding of public sector procurement regulations and governance frameworks.
Experience working within highly regulated or government-related programme environments.
Understanding of supplier performance management, KPI frameworks and commercial assurance processes.
Knowledge of NEC, FIDIC or other standard forms of contract.
Experience supporting programme-wide commercial governance and change control frameworks.
Qualifications
Degree in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Law, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Professional qualifications such as RICS, CICES, MCIPS or equivalent are desirable.

The UK CCB Consumer and Retail team covers corporate clients who produce or sell consumer goods, food and beverage. This individual will represent UK CCB externally as a senior market participant and is expected to operate at the highest level while also elevating the capability and culture of the broader team.

This individual understands how clients capitalise themselves, is highly knowledgeable about capital markets and commercial credit, and knows how to position Citi to compete for lead roles across the full product suite. • Monitor and support product implementation processes and client onboarding with the ability to coordinate internally and escalate to bring processes back on track

• Extensive experience in commercial banking, credit/risk management, and senior relationship management — with a demonstrable track record of originating new client relationships at a senior level
• In-depth knowledge of all aspects of commercial banking, including strong commercial credit knowledge and the ability to quickly learn and position new products and services

## Short Description

Based in the United Kingdom, this role offers the opportunity to work at the centre of the Bank’s Treasury function, supporting critical liquidity risk, funding and regulatory initiatives. The successful candidate will partner with senior leaders across the Group and contribute to high-profile projects with direct impact on the Bank’s balance sheet and strategic objectives.

## **Job Summary**

**This role could be based in UK and Singapore. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.**

•    Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.  Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda, including Funds Transfer Pricing (‘FTP’) and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).  
•    Within Treasury Liquidity, the Liquidity Risk Management (LRM) team will be responsible for establishing and implementing an effective framework for measuring, monitoring and managing the funding and liquidity risk across the Group and throughout the stress continuum (i.e., BAU, Recovery and Resolution). In addition, the team will be responsible to ensure the Group holds adequate liquidity buffer to sustain a range of severe stress scenarios and maintains a prudent funding profile in line with the PRA’s Internal Liquidity Adequacy Assessment Process (ILAAP) requirements.   
•    The LRM team responsibilities will be discharged through three pillars:               
•    Framework – Establish framework (Policies & Standards) to measure, monitor and manage the liquidity and funding risk.      
•    Modelling – Develop, maintain and enhance Models & Methodologies underpinning different liquidity metrics including stress testing. Simulations & Analytics – Build, maintain and run advanced simulation tools to provide granular liquidity modelling ("what-if" analysis) for recovery, resolution and ad-hoc management/regulatory scenarios.                                 
•    The Director, LRM role will be responsible for supporting multiple initiatives / projects across all the three pillars described above. The candidate will also get an opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders across the Group including Treasury, Businesses, Risk and Finance functions as well as externally with Regulators.

## **Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy** 
•    Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the liquidity framework is aligned to that. 
•    Support Global Head, LRM in: 
•    providing relevant inputs / guidance into Corporate Planning / Funding Planning process to ensure the liquidity risk is adequately captured. 
•    identifying key levers and emerging risks in relation to Group’s funding profile (e.g., due to change in market conditions or regulation) and present tangible and executable options to GALCO.

**Business** 
•    Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space. 
•    Provide support to Global Head, LRM in leading engagement with business stakeholders to understand the products and balance sheet needs, to interpret the risks, design and implement new/updated liquidity and funding metrics.

**Processes** 
**Assist line manager to manage:** 
•    End-to-end ILAAP process to ensure adherence to the underlying regulatory requirements as well as internal governance. 
•    Process to run simulations such as recovery and resolution scenarios.

**Risk Management** 
**Core Responsibilities:** 
•    Lead and drive the assigned projects independently. The breadth and depth of the projects offers a wide range including BAU policy / standard maintenance to a critical regulatory submissions like ILAAP to a bespoke model / methodology development. 
•    Collaborate with broader Treasury colleagues (particularly regional/country teams), Business stakeholders, Technology and Finance to socialise and implement the model/methodology changes. 
•    Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) and trusted advisor for liquidity risk topics by assisting the line manager in relation to: 
•    Design and implement models and methodologies to manage the liquidity and funding risk across the Group; 
•    Design different scenarios (for recovery, resolution or ad-hoc stress) and assess the liquidity impact by leveraging the internal simulation platform (T-Strats);   
•    Implement and maintain liquidity metrics in the technology platform (RCO & T-Strats); 
•    Interpret liquidity regulations (such as LCR, CFMR, NSFR);  
•    Assess liquidity impact from emerging areas like Climate Risk, Crypto Assets; and 
•    Provide SME input into policy review of new products (or changes to the existing products). 
•    Manage compliance with SCB’s internal governance standards such as model risk, EUC governance, operational risk control, prudential compliance framework and manage associated documentations. 
•    Actively contribute to the broader technology agenda to improve the liquidity platforms and data quality. 
•    Manage and liaise with internal / external auditors as well as with the Treasury CRO function as and when required.  
•    Assist the line manager in supporting the broader TL initiatives.

## **Skills and Experience**

**Must-have Skills**     
•    Action Oriented 
•    Instils Trust

**Other Skills**     
•    Customer Focus 
•    Nimble Learning

**Key Experiences**     
•    4-6 years of experience ideally in Treasury / Asset Liability Management (ALM) / Liquidity Risk function; 
•    Good knowledge of liquidity risk management practices and liquidity regulations such as LCR, NSFR (particularly PRA and HKMA regulations); 
•    Strong experience in building and maintaining the cash flow or behavioural models for different products (such as operational deposits, derivatives collateral outflow or interest rate risk) including model risk governance aspects;

Citi® Commercial Bank (CCB) is part of Citi, a leading global financial services company that has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in over 160 countries. Our bankers support a wide range of financial solutions: working capital, syndicated and bilateral loans, full range of capital markets products, treasury and liquidity management services, foreign exchange, trade finance and interest rate derivatives.

The Opportunity

The Citi Commercial Bank Head of Digital Technology & Communications (DT&C) for UK, Europe, and Middle East & Africa (“MEA”) provides executive leadership across multiple teams of Relationship Managers (RMs), Team Leaders, and product specialists. The role requires an in-depth understanding of how the DT&C sub-function contributes to achieving the broader commercial, financial, and strategic objectives of the franchise.

The Head of DT&C must possess an advanced understanding of the digital technology, communications, media, software/SaaS, digital infrastructure, telecommunications, AI ecosystems and platform ecosystems, including direct competitors’ capabilities, market disruptions, VC/PE sponsorship models, and evolving capitalization structures.

Excellent communication skills are required to negotiate internally, often at a senior level. Some external communication/negotiation may be necessary. The person will determine the approach to implementing functional strategy and will be accountable for end results, budgeting, planning, policy formulation and contribution to future strategy of the business. The role has full management responsibility for multiple teams, including management of people, budget, and planning, to include duties such as performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary actions and terminations and budget approval. The individual may be involved or responsible for diverse (cross-discipline) activities.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Business Expansion
• Set and execute the commercial growth agenda for the Digital Technology & Communications vertical across the UK, Europe, and MEA, fully aligned with regional and global CCB priorities.
• Shape the regional DT&C scorecard, actively contributing to regional planning, investment decisions, headcount allocation, and resource optimization at the CCB leadership table.

Client Leadership & Market Presence

P&L Ownership & Portfolio Management

Governance, Controls & Regulatory Interface

• Partner closely with Independent Risk, Compliance, and Country Citi Officers (CCOs) / Cluster Leaders to meet regional regulatory expectations and participate in key franchise governance processes.
• Safeguard Citigroup’s assets, reputation, and client trust by applying sound ethical judgment, establishing transparent escalation mechanisms, and enforcing personal and supervisory accountability.

Leadership, Talent Bench & Culture
• Lead and inspire multiple senior teams, including frontline bankers, team leaders, credit specialists, and industry analysts across diverse geographic markets.
• Build a deep, diverse leadership bench with proactive succession planning, continuous coaching, and a clear focus on attracting, developing, and retaining top-tier commercial banking talent.
• Foster an inclusive, high-performance environment characterized by client intensity, collaboration, accountability, and responsible growth.

Cross-Functional & Franchise Synergy
• Partner with Markets, TTS, Trade, Investment Banking and Wealth to deliver integrated, client centric solutions.
• Represent the DT&C vertical in UK, Europe & MEA and Global CCB leadership forums, influencing regional business strategy, risk appetite framework, and execution priorities.

AI Ecosystem
• Strategic Leadership & Business Expansion - Familiarity with the AI investment ecosystem — spanning LLM commercialisation, GPU/compute financing, and AI SaaS monetisation — to engage credibly with founders, CFOs, and VC/PE sponsors at the frontier of the sector.
• P&L Ownership & Portfolio Management - Ability to assess AI-specific client risk profiles, including revenue concentration in AI-integrated businesses, model obsolescence risk, and the disruptive impact of autonomous systems across cloud infrastructure, fintech, digital media, and enterprise software.
• Governance, Controls & Regulatory Interface - Awareness of the evolving AI regulatory landscape — including the EU AI Act and FCA guidance — to advise clients on compliance implications as they scale AI-driven business models across the UK, Europe, and MEA.

Development Value
• Direct opportunity to establish, scale, and manage a marquee industry vertical across major international markets with full P&L and operational ownership.
• Broadened managerial and leadership experience directing multi-jurisdictional, diverse teams of managers, bankers, and industry specialists.
• High-frequency interaction with Senior Risk leaders, CCOs, and regional executives, providing exposure to complex underwriting policies, cross-border regulatory frameworks, and market disruptions.
• Deep integration into Citi’s global corporate and investment banking ecosystem, expanding professional networks across product, industry, and geographic lines.

Qualifications & Experience
• 15+ Years of commercial or corporate banking experience in senior leadership roles with a demonstrated track record of commercial impact and revenue generation.
• Proven track record in managing a business with full P&L accountability, capital allocation, and budgeting responsibilities.
• At least 10 years of people management experience with a reputation for managing managers, developing leadership talent, and leading through organizational change.
• In-depth domain knowledge of the Digital Technology, Communications, SaaS, Digital Media, and Telecommunications sectors across the UK, Europe, and MEA.
• Deep expertise in corporate lending, credit structuring, cash management/liquidity, FX, trade finance, and capital markets solutions.
• Senior Credit Officer (SCO) designation or SCO-track strongly preferred.
• Proven strength in navigating a complex global matrix organization and influencing across regions, products, and control functions.
• Strong executive presence and communication skills to negotiate internally at the most senior levels and engage externally with C-suite executives, boards, and regulatory bodies.

Education

• Master’s Degree / MBA preferred.

What We Offer

• Access to Citi’s global platform and multi product capabilities.
• An inclusive, collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives.

Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

Citi technology are seeking a highly motivated IT professional to join our Production Services team support group in Belfast. The Prime Finance support group provides technical and business support for Citi’s Prime Finance Application stack, encompassing Prime brokerage and Securities Lending business streams. The applications are business critical, providing trade capture and maintenance for Trading, Sales, Middle Office and Operations.

Role / Position Overview:

We are searching for a highly motivated and enthusiastic person who will drive front line support functions as part of the Prime Finance Support team. We work in partnership with the business running the production platform, providing quick resolutions to their issues, drive stability, efficiency and effective improvements to help us and the business succeed.

The role will entail working closely with business partners, developing application knowledge, driving and tracking projects around stability and service improvement, incident resolution and follow-up activities and providing strategic technical solutions. You will develop detailed knowledge of the Prime Business. You will be working closely with your counterparts in India, UK, Hong Kong, US and Canada operating in a follow-the-sun global model, along with application developers and business analysts in the team.

Responsibilities:

• The Application Support Senior Analyst provides technical and business support for users of Citi Applcations. This includes providing quick resolutions to app issues, driving stability, efficiency and effectiveness improvements to help us and the business succeed.
• To provide direct user support for critical Prime Applications.
• To provide support for all Prime business issues.
• To develop, maintain and enhance monitoring solutions within the decided monitoring solution.
• To work off the central ticketing queue to handle all incoming business requests during core business hours.
• To ensure that the platform is operational for business during all business hours.
• To onboard new systems for support.
• To complete application support stability projects to improve current operational processes.
• To work with development teams to ensure change management process is implemented correctly.
• To work to create proactive solutions to ensure systems are resilient
• To analyze and trend all incoming service request metrics to identify stability projects
• Shift work, core coverage is 7am to 7pm .
• To work off an on call Rota for weekend work when required.

Skills:

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• Advanced experience with Unix/Linux operating systems, complex SQL queries, and financial messaging technologies (e.g., Solace, MQ, Kafka).
• Databases - Sybase, Microsoft SQL (Oracle/DB2 a plus) and Mongo
• Experience in trading and Middle office functions a bonus but not essential
• Monitoring and Automation Tools: Advance-level proficiency with batch scheduling tools (e.g., Autosys) and enterprise monitoring systems (e.g., ITRS Geneos).

Development Value:

• You will gain significant experience of the advanced technologies used to run our business regionally and globally, giving you the vast exposure to new and existing methodologies and systems.
• Work-Life Balance - At Citi, we offer flexible work plans that give employees and managers the chance to meet personal and business needs allowing for alternative schedules to customary business hours. 

Nice to have Skills:

• Technical Expertise: Act as the primary subject matter expert for Prime Brokerage or Securities Lending application functionalities, architecture, and interdependencies.
• Regulatory and Compliance Assurance: Understanding ternal regulatory mandates (e.g., SFTR, Dodd-Frank).
• Domain Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of the trade lifecycle, including trade booking, collateral management, and settlement cycles.
• Familiarity with industry-standard Securities Lending platforms (e.g., Equilend, Pirum) and associated data interfaces

Qualifications:

• Experience in an Application Support role.
• Experience installing, configuring or supporting business applications.
• Experience with some programming languages and willingness/ability to learn.
• Advanced execution capabilities and ability to adjust quickly to changes and re-prioritization
• Effective written and verbal communications including ability to explain technical issues in simple terms that non-IT staff can understand.
• Demonstrated analytical skills
• Issue tracking and reporting using tools
• Knowledge/ experience of problem Management Tools.
• Good all-round technical skills
• Effectively share information with other support team members and with other technology teams
• Ability to plan and organize workload
• Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to communicate appropriately to relevant stakeholder

Education:

• Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

By joining Citi, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:

· 27 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)

· Private Medical Care & Life Insurance
· Employee Assistance Program
· Pension Plan
· Paid Parental Leave
· Special discounts for employees, family, and friends
· Access to an array of learning and development resources

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self, every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay and empowered to thrive.

job_title: Senior Analyst, Structured Equity Middle Office
job_description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Analyst, Structured Equity Middle Office to join our Financial Markets Operations team in London.

This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of the trade lifecycle for complex structured equity and derivative transactions, working at the centre of our Front Office, Product Control, Finance, Technology, Risk and Compliance network. You will play a critical role in ensuring transactions are captured accurately, operational risks are effectively controlled and complex trade issues are resolved before they create financial, regulatory or client impact.

The role offers broad exposure to structured and vanilla Financial Markets products, including equity derivatives, convertible bonds, FX, listed futures and options, and interest-rate derivatives. You will also contribute to new-product launches, booking-model improvements, automation and the continued evolution of our global Financial Markets operating model.

Key Responsibilities

Trade Management and Lifecycle Control
•    Trade capture, coordination and lifecycle management of structured and vanilla Financial Markets transactions to maintain complete and reliable transaction records. Products include but not limited to: Equity Derivatives, FX, listed Futures/ Options, Convertible Bond, IR Derivatives.
•    Process trade amendments, resets, exercises, novations, terminations and other lifecycle events to ensure timely processing and appropriate control evidence.
•    Resolve trade exceptions and reconciliation breaks by coordinating investigation, remediation and escalation across Front Office, Product Control and operations teams.
•    Maintain effective controls across electronic and manual trade-processing channels, including relevant confirmation, execution and matching platforms.

Product, Risk and P&L Control
•    Apply product, risk and P&L knowledge to identify unusual transaction outcomes, unexplained movements and control exceptions requiring investigation.
•    Review trade and position information to detect booking errors, valuation dependencies and lifecycle discrepancies before financial or client impact occurs.
•    Coordinate with Front Office, Product Control and Finance to resolve issues affecting positions, P&L attribution and downstream financial information.
•    Ensure control responses are proportionate to the complexity and risk characteristics of FX, rates, credit, commodities, equities, money-market and structured products.

Service Delivery and Hub Oversight
•    Drive global alignment and consistency of processes under effective Follow the Sun support.
•    Monitor service levels, operational errors and recurring exceptions to identify gaps requiring escalation, remediation or additional control.
•    Review incident reports, root-cause analysis and mitigation plans to ensure corrective actions are sustainable, scalable and completed within agreed timelines.
•    Adapt global operating standards where legitimate local-market or regulatory requirements exist, while minimising unsupported non-standard processes.

Operational Risk, Governance and Regulatory Compliance
•    Identify, assess and escalate operational risks arising from trade processing, outsourced services, regulatory reporting and changes to Financial Markets processes.
•    Maintain compliance with the Operational Risk Framework, desk operating instructions, change-management requirements and applicable Group and country policies.
•    Represent Middle Office Operations in internal, external and regulatory reviews by providing clear control evidence and coordinating timely remediation of findings.
•    Oversee service-level reviews, business continuity testing and relevant outsourcing governance to confirm that operational arrangements remain effective and resilient.

Business Enablement and Operational Readiness
•    Assess operational readiness for new products, markets, booking models and strategic Financial Markets initiatives before implementation.
•    Define processing, control, capacity and service requirements with Front Office, Technology, Risk, Compliance and downstream operations teams.
•    Identify operational dependencies and implementation risks early enough to support informed go-live decisions and effective post-implementation monitoring.
•    Ensure new or changed processes are supported by appropriate procedures, ownership, training, controls and escalation routes.

Operating Model and Continuous Improvement
•    Contribute to global operating standards and target operating model development by identifying opportunities for simplification, standardisation and automation.
•    Partner with Technology to improve workflow, data quality and exception management across the transaction lifecycle.
•    Influence booking-model improvements with Front Office and control partners to reduce manual intervention, duplicated processing and operational risk.
•    Evaluate vendor services and operational arrangements to improve service quality, control effectiveness and lifecycle costs.

Skills and Experience

- Strong knowledge of structured equity products, particularly equity derivatives, and their end-to-end trade lifecycle.
- Sound understanding of trade capture, confirmations, settlements, positions, valuations, risk and P&L dependencies.
- Demonstrated ability to investigate complex trade exceptions, reconciliation breaks and operational incidents.
- Strong risk awareness, with the judgement to identify, assess and escalate control concerns promptly.
- Experience working with Front Office, Product Control, Finance, Technology, Risk, Compliance and geographically dispersed Operations teams.
- Excellent stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the confidence to act as a central point of contact for complex operational matters.
- A continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to challenge existing processes and drive practical improvements in efficiency, control and risk reduction.
- Experience supporting new-product approvals, booking-model changes, technology implementations or operational transformation initiatives.
- Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced Financial Markets environment.
- Resilience, adaptability and a strong sense of ownership when managing time-sensitive or high-risk issues.

Qualifications

- At least five years of relevant experience supporting equity derivatives and managing their associated trade lifecycle.
- Practical experience with Financial Markets systems such as FINIQ, APEX or Murex is highly desirable.
- Previous experience within a regulated banking, financial-services or capital-markets environment.
- Experience operating within a global or regional Middle Office function, ideally under a Follow the Sun service model.
- A degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Engineering or another relevant discipline would be advantageous.
- Relevant professional qualifications in financial markets, operations, risk or project management would be beneficial, but are not essential.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with the ability to analyse operational information and communicate findings clearly.
- Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

- Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
- In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
- Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
- Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
- Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
- Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
- A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Citi's Equities Technology organization is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Ultra Low Latency Risk Engine Developer to join the Equities Electronic Execution (Electronic Trading) technology team. This role is focused on the design, development, and delivery of Citi's next-generation low-latency Risk Engine for cash equities and its integration into the broader execution platform — encompassing the Centralised Position Service, Client Connectivity, Market Access layers, and high-throughput market data processing.

The engineer will own critical, latency-sensitive risk-checking components that sit directly in the cash equities trading hot path, ensuring pre-trade and real-time risk controls are enforced with microsecond-level performance while maintaining correctness and resiliency at scale. This is a hands-on, deeply technical role that also carries leadership responsibilities — mentoring engineers, driving architecture decisions, and coordinating delivery across global development centers.

The person will collaborate closely with product development, quantitative research, technology infrastructure, production support, and QA teams, with close alignment to global strategy and cross-regional delivery (APAC, EMEA, NAM).

Responsibilities:
• Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
• Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
• Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
• Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
• Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals
• Provide in-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions
• Serve as advisor or coach to mid-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary

Risk Engine & Core Development
• Design, develop, and maintain the ultra low-latency, in-line Risk Engine responsible for real-time pre-trade risk checks, position limits, and exposure controls across cash equities electronic execution flows.
• Architect and optimize high-performance, lock-minimal, multi-threaded components capable of processing risk decisions in the sub-microsecond to low-microsecond range.
• Integrate risk and position components with Client Connectivity, Market Access layers, and high-throughput market data feed handlers.
• Apply deep expertise in JVM performance tuning, memory management, garbage collection avoidance, and/or native (C++/Rust) performance engineering to eliminate latency outliers ("jitter") in the risk path.
• Perform system-level performance tuning to minimize end-to-end latency and jitter across the risk and execution path.

Recommended Qualifications:
• Proven software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on experience building risk management, position-keeping, or other latency-critical systems for cash equities electronic trading or algorithmic trading platforms at a global investment bank or equivalent financial institution.
• Strong, hands-on technical expertise in Low Latency Java and/or C++ (Rust a plus), including multi-threading, concurrency, lock-free data structures, Java NIO, and JVM/GC performance tuning.
• Hands-on experience with low-latency messaging and IPC frameworks such as Aeron, Solace, or equivalent shared-memory/IPC technologies for building distributed, high-throughput trading systems.

Experience of SAP S/4HANA, including S/4HANA migration programmes, would be particularly valuable.

What you’ll be doing
You’ll work closely with customers and project teams to understand their business processes and translate their requirements into practical SAP solutions.
Your role will include:
• Gathering and analysing business requirements and understanding how SAP ECC and S/4HANA can support the customer's Finance processes.
• Working directly with clients to understand their requirements, challenge where appropriate, and validate proposed solutions.
• Contributing to the wider SAP solution design, working collaboratively with colleagues across the DXC SAP practice and customer teams to keep projects moving forward. Be prepared to lead on engagements that incorporate a broader functional/technical scope requiring cross team collaboration.

• Understanding the impact of SAP changes on business processes, reporting and user interfaces, and recommending improvements where appropriate.
• Supporting customers with business process changes and improvement initiatives.
• Providing ongoing SAP functional support and working with technical teams and customers to investigate and resolve functional issues.
• Contributing to project activities across the full lifecycle, including proposal responses, solutioning, planning, mobilisation and implementation.
• Creating and maintaining clear project and functional documentation, including Requirements Traceability Matrices, Business Process Blueprints, Configuration Documentation, Functional Specifications, Test Scripts and Training Guides.
• Sharing your SAP Finance knowledge with colleagues and being open to developing your skills in new areas where customer demand requires it.
• Helping to strengthen the wider DXC SAP practice by bringing your experience, ideas and knowledge to new customer opportunities and solutions.

What we’re looking for
We’re looking for someone who combines strong SAP FICO knowledge with a genuine interest in understanding how businesses operate and helping customers solve their challenges.
You’ll ideally have:
• Strong experience working with SAP Finance/FICO in a consulting or client-facing environment.
• Experience gathering and analysing business requirements and translating them into SAP solutions.
• Experience of SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA, with S/4HANA experience particularly valuable.
• Experience supporting or contributing to S/4HANA migration programmes within your functional area.
• Experience working across the full SAP project lifecycle, from proposal response and solutioning through to planning, mobilisation, implementation and delivery.
• Experience managing and building relationships with client stakeholders.

• The confidence to work collaboratively within a project team while also taking ownership of your own area of responsibility including hands on.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical and business matters clearly to different audiences.
• A practical, analytical approach to problem solving and the ability to understand the wider business impact of an SAP issue or change.
• The ability to manage competing priorities and remain effective in a fast-paced project environment.

Job Description:
SAP Sales & Distribution Functional Analyst

About the role

We’re looking for an SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) Functional Analyst to join our team and play an important role in supporting and improving SAP solutions for our client.

This is a great opportunity for someone with hands-on experience in SAP SD who enjoys understanding how a business works, talking to users, solving problems and finding practical ways to make processes better.
You’ll work closely with both business users and technical teams, helping to understand what people need from SAP and turning those needs into effective solutions. You’ll be involved in everything from day-to-day support and troubleshooting through to configuration, testing, process improvements, and new developments.

You don’t need to know everything from day one. We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious, willing to learn and keen to broaden their SAP knowledge into other Logistics areas over time.

Due to the nature of the client environment, eligibility for security clearance is required for this role. To meet the current security requirements, candidates must be sole UK nationals and have lived and worked continuously in the UK for the past five years. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider dual nationals for this position.

What you'll be doing
• Working with business users to understand their requirements, challenges and day-to-day processes.
• Using your SAP SD knowledge to identify practical solutions that meet business needs.
• Helping to map current processes and design improved AS-IS and TO-BE processes.
• Configuring SAP and translating business requirements into clear functional specifications.
• Supporting the resolution of SAP SD issues, working closely with both users and technical colleagues.
• Helping to identify opportunities to improve existing processes and make better use of SAP.
• Creating and carrying out test scenarios to make sure changes work as expected.
• Supporting users through changes, including providing training and guidance where needed.
• Working with colleagues and sharing your knowledge to help others develop their SAP skills.
• Contributing to projects, enhancements and other SAP-related initiatives.
• Being open to learning and supporting other areas of SAP and Logistics functionality as your experience develops.

What we're looking for
We’re looking for someone who has:
• Relevant hands-on experience working with SAP Sales & Distribution (SD).
• Experience in business analysis, business solutions or a similar role.
• A good understanding of business processes and how SAP can support and improve them.
• Experience supporting users through business process changes or improvements.
• Experience working with both business and technical teams to resolve issues.
• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to listen, ask the right questions and turn business requirements into practical solutions.
• Experience creating and executing test scenarios.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• The confidence to explain technical concepts in a way that makes sense to non-technical audiences.
• A willingness to learn, develop and broaden your SAP knowledge.

An SAP certification would be great, but it isn't essential. We're also happy to support someone who is keen to work towards certification.

A degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

The kind of person who will enjoy this role
You’ll enjoy this role if you like getting to the bottom of a problem rather than simply fixing the symptom.
You’ll be comfortable speaking with different people across a business, from end users to technical specialists, and enjoy understanding what they need and finding a way to make things work.

We’re looking for someone who is approachable, curious and solutions-focused, with the confidence to take ownership while knowing when to ask for help.

Things don't always go to plan in SAP, so being able to manage changing priorities, stay calm when there are competing demands and work through problems logically is important.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to develop their skills and grow with the role, rather than someone who already knows everything.

Where you'll work
This is primarily a work-from-home role, giving you the flexibility to work remotely while remaining closely connected with the wider team and client.
There may be occasional travel to client sites for meetings, workshops or other business requirements.
From time to time, there may also be a requirement to work outside standard hours, including occasional weekends, depending on client and project requirements.

Why join us?
This is more than a role focused purely on keeping SAP running. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with users, understand real business challenges and see the impact of the solutions you help deliver.

In addition, DXC offers a competitive salary and a flexible benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally — including pension, private medical cover, and wellbeing programmes.

You'll also have the opportunity to develop your SAP skills, gain exposure to wider Logistics functionality, and build your experience across both functional and business-facing areas.

Security Delivery Lead

The Security Delivery Lead is the senior security subject matter expert (SME) accountable for the development, implementation, and maintenance of the security assurance regime across the service. This role owns the security policies, procedures, and governance framework that underpin the Contractor's compliance with client security requirements, accreditation obligations, and defence security standards.

This is a leadership and accountability role — not a technical implementation role. The Security Delivery Lead is responsible for ensuring the organisation's overall defence security posture is maintained, evidenced, and continuously improved. The role is the single point of accountability for security assurance, accreditation support, risk governance, and policy compliance across the service delivery lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Security Assurance Regime

• Develop, implement, and maintain the security assurance regime for the service — defining the framework, processes, activities, and evidence requirements that demonstrate ongoing security compliance.
• Establish and own the security assurance schedule — ensuring assurance activities are planned, executed, evidenced, and reported on a recurring basis.
• Define and maintain the security assurance evidence framework — specifying what evidence is required, how it is collected, where it is stored, and how it is presented to accreditation authorities and client security teams.

Accreditation Support & Maintenance

• Act as the Contractor's primary point of contact for all security accreditation matters — engaging with the client's Security Accreditation Authority, Information Asset Owners, and Senior Information Risk Owners (SIROs). 
• Support the accreditation lifecycle. 
• Maintain a register of all accreditation conditions, caveats, and risk acceptances — tracking compliance and closure. 

Security Policy & Procedure Development 

• Develop, maintain, and enforce security policies and procedures that ensure the Contractor's compliance.
• Conduct regular policy reviews to ensure currency with evolving client requirements, regulatory changes, and threat landscape developments. 
• Manage policy exceptions and deviations through a formal process — ensuring exceptions are risk-assessed, time-bound, approved, and tracked. 

Security Risk Governance 

• Establish and maintain the security risk governance framework for the service — defining how security risks are identified, assessed, recorded, escalated, treated, and reported. 
• Own and maintain the security risk register.
• Chair or participate in security risk governance forums — presenting risk posture, emerging threats, and treatment progress to senior leadership and client stakeholders. 

Compliance Management & Audit Support 
• Ensure the Contractor's ongoing compliance with all applicable security policies, standards, regulations, and contractual obligations. 
• Develop and maintain a compliance monitoring framework — defining what is monitored, how compliance is measured, and how non-compliance is addressed. 
• Conduct or commission regular compliance assessments.
• Manage non-compliance findings through a formal remediation process — ensuring findings are risk-assessed, prioritised, assigned, tracked, and closed. 
• Support internal and external security audits by providing evidence, documentation, and subject matter expertise. 
• Defence Security Posture Management.
• Maintain oversight of the overall defence security posture across the service — providing senior leadership and client stakeholders with a clear, evidence-based view of security health. 
• Identify and escalate security posture degradation — ensuring corrective action is taken before risks materialise. 
• Ensure the security posture is maintained during periods of change 

Personnel Security 

• Ensure all personnel (employees, contractors, sub-contractors) working on the service meet the required security clearance levels and vetting requirements. 
• Maintain oversight of personnel security compliance.
• Physical & Environmental Security.
• Ensure physical security controls for the service are appropriate to the classification and sensitivity of the environments supported. 
• Maintain oversight of physical security compliance. 
• Security Incident & Breach Management.
• Ensure security incident and breach management processes are defined, documented, tested, and aligned to client and regulatory requirements. 
• Provide senior security oversight of security incidents 
• Ensure security incident trends are analysed and feed into risk governance, assurance activities, and process improvement.

Security Architecture Design & Development

Security Toolset Tech Refresh & Evergreening

Cross-Domain Architecture & Pattern Alignment

Cloud Security Architecture

Keep our global cloud platform reliable, scalable, and resilient.
Do you enjoy solving complex production challenges before they turn into incidents? Are you the kind of engineer who automates repetitive tasks, improves reliability through engineering, and believes that every outage is an opportunity to build a better system? And are you an experienced, hands-on engineer who wants to stay close to the technology rather than move into people management?
We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the Global Platform Team at Vertage. In this role, you'll help build and operate the cloud platform that powers our global Workforce-as-a-Service (WaaS) ecosystem. You'll work alongside Cloud Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI specialists to improve platform resilience, reduce operational overhead, and ensure that our Azure-based engineering environment remains reliable, scalable, and resilient. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, with no people management responsibilities.
Your impact
As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, your focus is to keep our platforms healthy, reliable, and easy to operate while continuously improving how we build, run and recover production systems.
You'll help build the engineering foundations behind our Headless Data Architecture (HDA), which runs on Azure and Databricks, as well as the Custom Apps Infrastructure (CA) that powers integrations, internal applications, and operational workflows across our international organization.
Instead of spending your days reacting to incidents, you'll focus on preventing them through automation, observability, and reliability engineering. You'll reduce operational burden, improve platform resilience, and build systems that scale, recover automatically whenever possible, and provide engineering teams across Cloud, Data, and AI with the visibility they need to run production workloads with confidence.
What you will do
Improve the reliability, availability, and performance of our Azure platform and production environments.
Build and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting using Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics.
Automate operational tasks and eliminate repetitive manual work using Infrastructure as Code and scripting.
Design self-healing capabilities and automated remediation to reduce incidents and improve recovery times.
Investigate production incidents, perform root cause analyses, and implement long-term improvements.
Define, measure, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
Optimize platform performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Work closely with Cloud Engineers to improve platform design, resilience, security, and operational reliability.
Support Data and AI teams by improving the reliability of Azure Databricks environments.
Help shape and raise engineering standards around observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Continuously look for opportunities to reduce operational complexity and improve developer productivity.
Act as a technical point of reference for reliability engineering, helping shape technical decisions while remaining hands-on in the technology.
About the role
As part of the Global Platform Team, you'll work alongside engineers in Cloud, Data, and AI to improve the reliability of our Azure-based platform. Using technologies such as Kubernetes, Terraform, Databricks, GitHub Actions, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry, you'll help ensure that our global Workforce-as-a-Service ecosystem remains reliable, scalable, and resilient.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will have significant technical ownership and will be expected to get into the detail when needed, from troubleshooting complex production issues to improving automation, observability and system reliability. You will act as a technical reference point for others, but you will not have people management responsibilities.
About Vertage
Vertage is one of Europe's leading providers of workforce and talent solutions. Operating across multiple countries, we are transforming into a cloud-native, AI-powered organization that connects people, technology, and data through a modern digital platform. The Global Platform Team is at the heart of that transformation, enabling engineering teams across Cloud, Data, AI, and Software Engineering to build and operate scalable solutions for the future.

You're passionate about building reliable systems and solving operational challenges through engineering rather than manual intervention. You enjoy understanding how distributed systems behave, thrive in cloud-native environments, and are always looking for ways to improve automation, resilience, and observability. You stay calm under pressure, take ownership of problems, and enjoy collaborating with others to continuously improve the platform's reliability.
You have significant experience operating production systems and still enjoy getting hands-on. You are comfortable working independently, making technical decisions and going deep into complex problems. While you may naturally act as a technical reference point for others, you are not looking for a people management role.
7+ years of experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Cloud Engineer, with significant hands-on experience in production environments.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
Experience with observability tools such as Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, or Log Analytics.
Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, or similar languages.
Experience supporting distributed cloud platforms in production.
Experience with incident management, root cause analysis, and post-incident improvements.
Familiarity with GitOps principles and modern deployment practices.
Experience with Azure Databricks is a strong advantage.
Experience with SnapLogic or similar integration platforms is a plus.
A strong preference for staying hands-on and solving technical problems directly, rather than moving into people management.

ABOUT THE ROLE 💡

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help make Voicemod's analytics AI-driven. Your mission is to build AI-ready data: the best data and context, so AI can get the most out of it.

This is a full-stack role. You will design event tracking plans with product teams, build and run the ingestion pipelines that land our data in Snowflake, and model it in dbt. Just as important, you will make that data AI-ready, with the metric definitions, documentation and semantic models that let AI tools and people alike get accurate, trustworthy answers.

Our stack: We run a hybrid model: Amplitude for real-time product analytics, and Snowflake with dbt for slower, exact reporting. Data lands through Weld, Stitch and dltHub, orchestrated with Airflow.




WHAT YOU’LL DO 🎯

 - AI-ready data: design the semantic layer and metadata (descriptions, metric definitions, business context) that let AI tools query our data accurately, and help move our reporting beyond Looker.

 - dbt modelling: develop dbt models that turn raw data into reliable, documented datasets ready for final consumption.

 - Keep real-time (Amplitude) and exact (Snowflake and dbt) reporting consistent, so the same metric means the same thing in both places.

 - Build, run and monitor ingestion pipelines with Weld, Stitch and dltHub, bringing product, payments, marketing and third-party data into Snowflake.

 - Orchestrate pipelines in Airflow, with alerting and clear recovery paths.

 


WHAT YOU’LL NEED ✅

 - Solid experience in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering, with advanced SQL skills.

 - Hands-on experience with dbt and a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake.

 - Experience designing event tracking plans with product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel or Segment.

 - Experience with ELT and data integration tools such as Weld, Stitch, dltHub or Fivetran.

 - Experience orchestrating workflows with Airflow or a similar tool.

 - Solid knowledge of data modelling (dimensional modelling, incremental models, slowly changing dimensions).

 - Comfort working directly with engineers, product managers and analysts, and translating their needs into data products.

• Works with both internal and external partner engineering teams as necessary, and serves as the subject matter expert (SME) for each integration owned.

• Represents the voice of partners, taking a data-driven approach to surface key partner insights and using them to improve our integration experience.

Job Title: Senior Indirect Tax Manager

Reports to: VP, EMEA Services Centre

A little bit about our team:
Warner Music’s EMEA Shared Service Centre is the home to the financial, tax and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our European Recorded Music and Publishing businesses. The UK Centre embodies the innovative and creative spirit that stems from the company’s deep history in nurturing entrepreneurial thinking and artist-focused innovation, enabling our employees to develop a wide range of skills through cross-function collaboration and development opportunities.

The Indirect Tax Team sits within our EMEA Shared Services Centre and provides tax compliance across the region for all business lines. As WMG transitions to SAP S/4HANA, the team plays a crucial role in embedding tax processes into new systems and ensuring data integrity and compliance across multiple territories.

Your role:
As the Senior Indirect Tax Manager, you will report directly to the VP, EMEA Services Centre and take overall ownership of indirect tax compliance across Europe. You will lead and mentor a team of indirect tax professionals, transforming the compliance function into a true Centre of Excellence. In addition to regional compliance, you will play a vital role in global indirect tax governance, establishing standards and controls that resonate worldwide.

A critical component of this role involves spearheading our digital tax transformation. You will partner closely with the Finance Transformation ("FIT") team to ensure our systems—specifically the OneSource Compliance tool—are expertly configured to drive the automated, seamless generation of indirect tax returns.

Key Responsibilities:
• Overall European Compliance & Process Ownership
• Assume overall responsibility and accountability for end-to-end indirect tax compliance (VAT, GST, WHT, etc.) across all European territories.

• Ensure the timely and highly accurate preparation, review, and submission of all returns, maintaining rigorous adherence to local regulations.

• People Management & Leadership
• Line manage the Indirect Tax Managers and oversee a broader team of Tax Analysts.

• Drive talent development, build team capability, manage performance, and foster a high-performing, collaborative culture where your team is recognized as the go-to experts within WMG.

• Finance Transformation & Automation
• Act as the primary tax liaison with the Finance Transformation ("FIT") team.

• Direct the configuration, testing, and deployment of the OneSource Compliance tool, ensuring it is appropriately optimized for the automated generation of indirect tax returns.

• Champion the integration of tax processes in alignment with the SAP S/4HANA deployment.

• Global Indirect Tax Governance
• Establish, monitor, and enforce robust internal controls, standard operating procedures, and risk management frameworks for indirect tax processes.

• Drive elements of global governance by standardizing best practices, aligning European operations with broader WMG global tax policies, and mitigating cross-border tax risks.

• Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
• Serve as a senior trusted advisor to leadership, non-tax stakeholders, local finance teams, and record labels regarding complex tax issues and business changes.

• Coordinate with the central Corporate Tax Team on complex advisory, policy, and technical controversy matters.

About you:
• You have a bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, tax, or a related field (a relevant professional qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CTA, or equivalent is highly preferred).

• You bring 8+ years’ experience in indirect tax within a multinational organization or top-tier professional services firm, with a strong focus on compliance and governance.

• You possess proven people management experience, with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams.

• You have a comprehensive, expert-level understanding of indirect and withholding tax regulations across Europe.

• You have significant experience driving tax technology and finance transformation projects, with specific, hands-on expertise in configuring and utilizing tax engines like ONESOURCE and ERPs like SAP S/4HANA.

• You are highly articulate, with the ability to translate complex tax and technology requirements into clear strategies for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You are a strategic thinker who can balance day-to-day operational execution with global governance and long-term process innovation.

We’d love it if you also had:
• Fluency in English and proficiency in an additional European language (e.g., French, German, Italian, Spanish).

• Experience navigating and leading through large-scale corporate system migrations.

• Deep knowledge of GAAP-to-tax adjustments and complex data mapping for tax automation.

We bring together talent from Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to push beyond conventional modelling approaches and translate cutting-edge research into actionable signals across global markets. Our culture is built around intellectual honesty, independence of thought, and a deep respect for evidence over narrative. We value researchers who are willing to challenge assumptions, explore uncomfortable ideas, and iterate quickly in the face of uncertainty. Collaboration is not ornamental here, it is structural. We are searching for researchers who have a history of using machine learning for solving challenging, realistic problems, not benchmark problems pretending to be progress. It's intrinsically end-to-end: spotting problems that matter, specifically where there's an advantage in developing LLM skills, and pushing them through the full development process.
You will be working with our traders, figuring out what constraints exist, what data looks like in practice, and what signals are realistically possible. From there, it becomes an exercise in iterating until your models, tools, and infrastructure don't collapse the first time you encounter real-world markets.
The field is intentionally wide. Your projects could land anywhere on the research pipeline for quant finance, wherever you can turn unstructured data and cutting-edge machine learning techniques into economically valuable insights.
We're not asking for excellence everywhere. You should be able to reason clearly about quantitative problems, communicate effectively with trading researchers, and maintain a consistent, dependable working rhythm.

Experience working with HPC environments or training large models in distributed settings, along with some exposure to GPU-level optimisation using CUDA or ROCm. A track record of taking models end-to-end, particularly in the context of LLMs, is valuable. Prior academic publications or meaningful contributions to open-source AI work are a plus.
